summaries.specs-author: Designs a change as a spec in `specs/` with `cmd-spdd.sh`, stage by stage and gate by gate; reviews, reads and checks a spec for drift; keeps the shared specs in step
summaries.specs-workflow: How work is done in `specs/`: what a spec is, the stages and their gates, every action of `cmd-spdd.sh`, the shared specs, the settings keys
summaries.specs-start: `/specs-start <workspace>/<project> <what the change is>`: starts the spec, hands the story over and says what the next gate is
summaries.specs-design-a-change: A new session that designs a change as a spec: story by questions, review, analysis, then waits
